_comment: Template for the PACKET distribution method, for rt-mbs-application-provider. Loaded twice,
like every template here: once on the MBS User Services card for the 'service' block, once on
the Ingest Sessions card for the 'sessions' array. See templates/README.md.
PACKET carries a packet stream through the transport function rather than delivering discrete
objects over FLUTE, so none of the object parameters (operating mode, acquisition method,
object IDs) apply and none are present below. Use it for a stream that is already packetised
at the source; use OBJECT for files and for DASH or HLS presentations.
_subscription: Optional. When present, loading this template on the Ingest Sessions card prefills the Status
Subscription form beneath it -- the notification URI, and the events ticked below. It does not
subscribe: that stays a deliberate, separate step, like creating the service and the session.
A subscription is per Ingest Session, so it cannot be prepared until the session exists, which
is why the form only appears once one has been created.
The events below are the ones that tell you whether delivery actually started, plus the two
failure events that explain a session that never does. Tick more in the form if you want the
full lifecycle; the running MBSF's own list is what the form offers, and an event named here
that it does not offer is reported rather than silently dropped.

_distrMethod: Selecting PACKET makes pckDistrInfo below the parameter set that applies; objDistrInfo is
not sent at all. TS 29.580 Nmbsf_MBSUserDataIngestSession defines the two as alternatives.
_pckDistrInfo: All three fields are required. operatingMode is PACKET_PROXY (the transport function
terminates the ingest and re-originates the packets) or PACKET_FORWARD_ONLY (it forwards
them unchanged). pckIngMethod is MULTICAST or UNICAST. ingEndpointAddrs is where the
transport function expects the incoming stream.
